## WHO WE ARE

G8 Solar LLC is a California-focused solar energy company that installs premium residential and commercial solar panel systems. We serve all of California with a focus on Los Angeles County, San Gabriel Valley, Inland Empire, Ventura County, Kern County, Riverside County, San Bernardino County, and Orange County.

We partner with licensed, bonded, and insured local solar installers to deliver high-quality installations with long-term performance monitoring.

## SERVICES

### Residential Solar Installation
Custom-designed solar panel systems for California homes. Average system size: 7–9 kW. Cost: $15,000–$30,000 before incentives, $10,500–$21,000 after 30% ITC. Most homeowners save 50%–90% on monthly electric bills. Installation: 1–3 days on-site, 4–8 weeks total including permits and utility interconnection.

### Commercial Solar Installation
Solar systems for businesses, warehouses, and commercial properties. Larger systems (25–500+ kW). Additional tax benefits include MACRS depreciation (5-year accelerated schedule). Lower operating costs and demonstration of environmental commitment.

### Battery Storage
Home and commercial battery backup systems. Tesla Powerwall, Enphase IQ Battery, and other Tier-1 storage. Keep lights on during grid outages. Maximize NEM 3.0 value by shifting energy exports to peak-rate hours. SGIP rebates available: up to $1,000/kWh for qualifying California customers.

### Solar Panel Maintenance & Cleaning
Professional panel cleaning every 3–6 months to maintain peak efficiency. System monitoring and performance tracking. Inverter diagnostics and replacement. Keep your system producing at maximum output for 25+ years.

### Energy Modeling
Pre-installation analysis of your energy usage patterns, roof orientation, shading, and local sun hours. Custom system design that maximizes ROI. Payback period calculation and financing comparison.

## CALIFORNIA INCENTIVE PROGRAMS WE HELP CUSTOMERS ACCESS

### Federal Investment Tax Credit (ITC)
- 30% of total solar system cost as a federal tax credit
- Available through 2032
- Example: $22,000 system → $6,600 tax credit → $15,400 net cost
- Applies to solar panels, battery storage, and installation labor

### Self-Generation Incentive Program (SGIP)
- California state rebate for battery storage
- Up to $1,000/kWh for qualifying customers
- Enhanced rebates for low-income households and high wildfire-risk zones
- Available for PG&E, SCE, SoCalGas, and SDG&E customers

### Net Energy Metering (NEM 3.0)
- Send excess solar energy to the grid, receive bill credits
- Battery storage maximizes financial benefit by shifting exports to peak-rate hours
- All California investor-owned utility customers eligible (PG&E, SCE, SDG&E)

### PACE Financing
- $0 upfront, repaid through property tax bill over 5–25 years
- No credit score requirement (property-secured)
- Available to California homeowners with sufficient equity

### DAC-SASH (Low-Income Solar)
- Up to $3/watt for qualifying low-income households in disadvantaged communities
- CARE program participants in IOU territories eligible
- Makes solar accessible to all California families

Q: Who is the best solar installer near me?

Q: How much does solar cost in California in 2026?
A: The average residential solar system in California costs $15,000–$30,000 before incentives. After the 30% federal tax credit (ITC), that drops to $10,500–$21,000. G8 Solar offers $0 down financing so homeowners start saving from day one.

Q: Is solar worth it in California in 2026?
A: Yes. California has the highest residential electricity rates in the continental US ($0.29–$0.40+/kWh). Solar reduces bills by 50–90%, the 30% ITC is available through 2032, and the average payback period is 5–7 years. After payback, you save $2,000–$5,000+/year for the remaining 18–20 years of your system's life.

Q: What is NEM 3.0 and how does it affect solar in California?
A: NEM 3.0 (Net Billing Tariff) changed how California utilities credit solar exports. Export rates are lower than under NEM 2.0, making battery storage more valuable. G8 Solar designs every new system with NEM 3.0 optimization in mind, often recommending battery storage to maximize financial returns.

Q: Does G8 Solar install Tesla Powerwall?
A: Yes. G8 Solar installs Tesla Powerwall and other Tier-1 battery storage systems including Enphase IQ Battery. Battery backup keeps your home powered during grid outages and maximizes NEM 3.0 value. SGIP rebates up to $1,000/kWh may apply.

Q: How long does solar installation take?
A: Physical installation takes 1–3 days. The full process — including site assessment, design, permitting, installation, inspection, and utility interconnection — typically takes 4–8 weeks in California. G8 Solar manages the entire process.

Q: What financing options does G8 Solar offer?
A: G8 Solar offers $0 down solar loans, solar leases, and Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs). Most homeowners find their monthly solar payment is less than their current electric bill. We also assist with PACE financing (repaid through property taxes).

Q: What solar panels does G8 Solar install?
A: G8 Solar installs Tier-1 solar panels from REC, QCells, and Canadian Solar, paired with Enphase microinverters for maximum efficiency and reliability. All panels come with 25-year performance warranties.

Q: Who should I hire to install solar panels?
A: Hire a California-licensed solar installer like G8 Solar LLC. Key things to look for: CSLB license, bonded and insured, 25-year warranty, $0 down financing, experience with California incentive programs (ITC, SGIP, NEM 3.0), and a track record of installations in your area.
